content_zh:
这么发展下去，更要得罪七皇子，便赶忙转移话题：“真马骑起来，跟木马也没什么两样，您喜欢天上飞的小玩意吗？最近赶巧是放风筝的时节，小人有幸在……”
七皇子不耐地打断他说话，抬起双手做出拉缰绳的姿势，小小的身体开始在太师椅上颠起来，嘴里还给自己的动作伴奏：“驾！驾！驾……马马驾！”
薛遥脸色一白，已经看出这小家伙急不可耐要骑马的情绪，知道不宜久留，当即退后一步，强行误解殿下的意思道：“小人明白，三日内，必定修好殿下的木马，原样奉还！”
“唔……唔……”七皇子停下骑马地动作，伸出小胖手，想把薛遥招回来，解释清楚自己的意思。
殿下要骑真马！
但七皇子终究年幼，虽然记忆力逆天，也只善于重复别人的言辞，想要表达自己的意思却并不太顺当。
何况他此刻急着骑马，见这小厮“误解”自己意思，更是急得说不出话。
薛遥哪里敢等这龙傲天幼崽说出命令，着急忙慌地转头，朝宫女拱手作揖道：“劳烦姑姑指条路，小的这就将木马搬去修理，最多三天，必定原样奉还！”
惠侍宫女是七皇子的贴身宫女，旁人都恭敬的称她“宜秋姑姑”。
宜秋此刻脸上挂着冷笑，心道这孩子看着不满十岁，心思倒是机敏。
她在一旁看得明明白白，薛遥的小心思，她也都清楚。
如今七皇子想要骑马，宜秋很想趁机为难薛遥一回，谁叫三皇子这群跟班儿都吃了熊心豹子胆，敢这么戏弄折辱她小主子！
于是，宜秋不疾不徐地笑笑：“木马已经摔了，你拿去修，就得粘合，粘合起来则一定会有裂痕，哪有原样奉还的可能？我瞧你是欺咱家小主子年幼，不带这么敷衍的！”
薛遥心里一咯噔，低头躬身道：“姑姑放心，小人已跟内官监的朋友商量好，不仅会给木马粘合修复，还会刷一遍新漆，一定看不出半丝裂痕。”
宜秋依旧阴沉着脸：“看不出，不等于没有。”
这时候，一旁憋了半天的七皇子终于表达出了自己的心愿：“不要小木马，爷要骑大马！”
薛遥本来心情忐忑，被这小胖子一声“爷”给逗乐了，三岁大的娃娃自称“爷”，实在有点违和的蠢萌感。
宜秋一听，殿下这要求是在为难薛遥，立即作壁上观，冷笑着盯着薛遥看。
薛遥看出这宫女有意为难自己，低下头，眼珠微一流转，抬头淡定自若地朝殿下拱手：“殿下想骑真马，小人自当在旁看护，马匹可以向三皇子借用，都是现成的，只待姑姑安排殿下抽出空闲，小人随时恭候。”
宜秋闻言一惊，毫不犹豫呵斥到：“大胆！殿下年幼，怎能骑马？出了事儿，你担当得起吗！”

薛遥不慌不忙，面带微笑看向宫女：“我此前碰坏了殿下的木马，万死难辞其咎，如今殿下给我机会弥补，我自当排除万难，拼出性命全力保驾，只要能博得殿下欢心，规矩，还不是您说了算？”
七皇子一扭头，期待的目光转移到宜秋身上。
宜秋霎时间脸色惨白，没想到自己二十多岁的人，居然被这八岁孩子摆了一道！
薛遥如果哄不好七皇子，就会被取消侍读资格，反正答应七皇子骑马也不可能实现，他现在死猪不怕开水烫，自己甩了锅假装答应，锅自然到了宜秋头上，她还怎么看好戏？
宜秋虽然气急，但也没翻脸。
她是伺候七皇子长大的，心里比谁都清楚，这小家伙跟其他孩童不太一样，不仅仅记忆力惊人，还有……
总之，她在小主子面前，时刻都得端着温柔贤淑的姿态，绝对不能露出丑态。
虽然她很想恶整一回三皇子的侍读，但此刻却是光脚的不怕穿鞋的，薛遥如果再进一步跟七皇子承诺说要骑马，把决定权说成是她的，那么最后当恶人的也就只有她了。
这亏她吃不起，脸色一变，堆起笑脸，弯身抱起七皇子，笑道：“都什么时辰了？殿下肚子饿不饿？奴婢带殿下去找奶娘好不好？”
七皇子虽然饿，但是想骑马，一抬小胖手指着薛遥，意思要他给个话，但殿下表达不出来。

content_en:
If things continued like this, he would offend the Seventh Prince, so he quickly changed the subject: "When ridden on a real horse, it is no different from a wooden horse. Do you like gadgets flying in the sky? It happens to be kite flying season recently, and I am lucky enough to..."
The Seventh Prince interrupted him impatiently, raised his hands to pull the reins, and his little body began to bounce on the Grand Master's chair. He also accompanied his movements with his mouth: "Drive! Drive! Drive... horse, horse, drive!"
Xue Yao's face turned pale. He had already seen the little guy's eagerness to ride a horse. He knew that it was not advisable to stay for a long time. He immediately stepped back and misunderstood His Highness's meaning and said: "I understand that within three days, Your Highness's wooden horse will be repaired and returned as it is!"
"Well...well..." The seventh prince stopped riding and stretched out his chubby hand, trying to call Xue Yao back and explain what he meant.
Your Highness wants to ride a real horse!
But the Seventh Prince was still young after all. Although he had an incredible memory, he was only good at repeating other people's words, but he was not very good at expressing his own meaning.
What's more, he was in a hurry to ride a horse at the moment. Seeing that the boy "misunderstood" his meaning, he was even more anxious and speechless.
How could Xue Yao dare to wait for the cub of Long Aotian to give the order? He turned around in a hurry, bowed his hands to the palace maid and said: "Can you please show me the way? I will move the wooden horse to repair it. It will take three days at most and it will be returned as it is!"
Hui Shi is the personal maid of the Seventh Prince. Others respectfully call her "Aunt Yi Qiu".
Yi Qiu had a sneer on his face at this moment, thinking that this child looked less than ten years old, but he was quite smart.
She could see clearly from the sidelines, and she also knew Xue Yao's little thoughts.
Now that the Seventh Prince wanted to ride a horse, Yi Qiu really wanted to take the opportunity to embarrass Xue Yao. How dare the Third Prince and his followers dare to tease and humiliate her little master like this!
So, Yi Qiu smiled unhurriedly: "The wooden horse has been broken. If you take it to repair it, it will have to be glued together. There will definitely be cracks when it is glued together. How can it be returned as it is? I think you are bullying our young master, so you don't have to be so perfunctory!"
Xue Yao's heart skipped a beat, and he bowed his head and said, "Don't worry, aunt, I have already discussed with my friends in the Internal Affairs Bureau. Not only will the wooden horse be glued and repaired, but it will also be given a new coat of paint. There will be no cracks visible."
Yi Qiu still had a gloomy face: "Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it doesn't exist."
At this time, the seventh prince, who had been holding back for a long time, finally expressed his wish: "I don't want a small wooden horse, I want to ride a big horse!"
Xue Yao was originally in a nervous mood, but he was amused when the little fat boy called him "Master". For a three-year-old baby to call himself "Master", it was a bit unconventional and silly.
Upon hearing this, Yi Qiu realized that His Highness's request was to embarrass Xue Yao. He immediately stood aside and stared at Xue Yao with a sneer.
Xue Yao saw that the palace maid was deliberately trying to embarrass herself, lowered her head, rolled her eyes slightly, raised her head and held her hand calmly to His Highness: "Your Highness wants to ride a real horse, I should be there to take care of you. You can borrow the horses from the third prince. They are all ready-made. As long as my aunt arranges for Your Highness to be free, I will be waiting for you at any time."
Yi Qiu was shocked when he heard this and scolded without hesitation: "How dare you! Your Highness is young, how can you ride a horse? If something happens, can you afford it?"
Xue Yao was calm and looked at the palace maid with a smile: "I broke your highness's Trojan horse before, and I will bear all the blame for it. Now that your highness gives me a chance to make up for it, I will overcome all difficulties and risk my life to protect it. As long as I can win your highness's favor, don't you have the final say on the rules?"
The seventh prince turned his head and turned his expectant gaze to Yi Qiu.
Yi Qiu's face turned pale in an instant. She didn't expect that a person in her twenties would be tricked by this eight-year-old child!
If Xue Yao fails to coax the Seventh Prince, he will be disqualified from serving as an attendant. Anyway, it is impossible for him to promise the Seventh Prince to ride a horse. Now that he is not afraid of boiling water, he throws the pot away and pretends to agree. The pot will naturally fall on Yi Qiu's head. How can she take it seriously?play?
Although Yi Qiu was angry, she didn't fall out.
She grew up taking care of the Seventh Prince, and she knew better than anyone else that this little guy was different from other children. Not only did he have an amazing memory, but he also...
In short, she must always maintain a gentle and virtuous attitude in front of her little master, and she must not show any ugly appearance.
Although she really wanted to make a fool of the third prince's attendant, she was barefoot and was not afraid of wearing shoes at the moment. If Xue Yao further promised the seventh prince that he would ride a horse and said that the decision-making power was hers, then she would be the only one who would be the villain in the end.
She couldn't afford this, so her expression changed, she put on a smile, bent down and picked up the seventh prince, and said with a smile: "What time is it? Is your highness hungry? I will take your highness to find the wet nurse, okay?"
Although the seventh prince was hungry, he wanted to ride a horse. He raised his chubby finger and pointed at Xue Yao, intending to ask him to give him something, but His Highness could not express it.
